description: The Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances of the U.S. Census Bureau is described by the Bureau as the only nationwide, complete source of local government finance data collected with uniform definitions. It reports revenue, expenditure, debt and assets (cash and security holdings) by government function for the 50 states, the District of Columbia and the nation, for state governments, local governments and both combined. Item codes cover functions such as highways and toll highways, air transportation, water transport and terminals, sewerage, solid waste management, water supply, electric power, gas supply and transit utilities, split into charges or utility revenue, current operation and construction, so public infrastructure spending can be tracked by state and year. Individual Unit Files give record-level amounts by item code for every government in the annual sample, and the companion Annual Survey of State Government Finances (ASFIN) gives tables for each state government. Coverage: collected annually since 1957, a census of all governments in years ending 2 and 7 and a sample in between; 2024 data released July 2026 and revised 2022 and 2023 data. Access: XLSX tables and ZIP unit files with technical documentation on www2.census.gov, data.census.gov and the govslocalfin and govsstatefin APIs (free key); free and public domain. Caveats: sample years are estimates with coefficients of variation; item codes need the Government Finance and Employment Classification Manual; public utility enterprises and dependent agencies are reported under their parent government. Simulation uses: capital and operating cost baselines for public infrastructure, investment gap and asset management models. Related records: the government units listing, the public employment survey and construction spending.
